search_audit.query: site:cns11643.gov.tw/wordView.jsp 嗎 U+55CE Mandarin ma 馬 U+99AC mǎ
search_audit.outcome: Search surfaced the official character pages. Opened and inspected the 嗎 and 馬 pages; they verify neutral-tone ma for 嗎 and third-tone mǎ for 馬. Other results included simplified forms, but they were not needed for the reviewed comparison.

search_audit.query: Unicode Unihan U+55CE 嗎 kMandarin U+99AC 馬
search_audit.outcome: Opened both official character-specific Unihan URLs; the web tool returned access errors for both. The official CNS11643 pages provide current Mandarin readings, but do not replace the requested Unihan records.

gaps: The review asks for a modern Mandarin reading comparison, which is supported by the inspected government character pages: 馬 mǎ and 嗎 ma (neutral tone). These current readings do not establish an ancient phonetic relationship, and the analysis remains scoped to the traditional 嗎-as-罵 account in the dossier.

The official Unicode Unihan character-specific records for U+55CE and U+99AC remained inaccessible in this run. No claim about their exact kMandarin fields is made. No glyph image was newly researched for this reading-only correction.
